comments.author: unknown
comments.body:
⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: AC1 "one basis" invariant has a reachable counterexample — boundary-less windowed resumes re-arm phantom anchors through `refreshAgentState`**

The fix makes the projection the single anchor authority, and `_resetStaleUsageAnchors` (session_tree.dart:874-886) resets only entries **before the last boundary record** (`CompactionRecord` / `HiddenRangeRecord` / `CompactCheckpointRecord`). A resident tail that contains **no** boundary record returns `staleEntryIds = const {}`, so the rebuild at this line re-arms every persisted generation-time usage anchor — exactly the anchors the CLI's resume path deliberately zeroed one line after loading:

- `lib/src/cli/session_commands.dart:962` — `_agent.state.messages = resetLoadedUsageAnchors(messages)` with the comment: *"Loaded usage anchors are generation-time: post-compaction they phantom-report the pre-compaction size (183k on a 27k branch) and fire a no-op compaction on every resume. Re-anchor at chars/4."*

**The divergent sequence**: a windowed resume whose boundary-walk exhausts `maxPages` (session_commands.dart logs *"boundary-walk exhausted maxPages; proceeding with the tail window"*) leaves a boundary-less giant tail; the resume zeroes anchors → the gate arms on the chars/4 basis; the engine's refresh at this line then re-arms the persisted phantom anchor → `estimateRequestTokens` anchors at the pre-trim size (`token_estimation.dart:489-493` — any anchor suppresses the overhead addend and prices the whole request). Engine basis ≠ gate basis — the gh-2237 divergence class, opposite direction: the engine chases the phantom number, folds/hides far past the real over-amount, and burns hide/checkpoint provider passes until a fold's own `HiddenRangeRecord` lands a boundary and re-collapses the basis. Cost is bounded (one over-aggressive fold, self-healing, hides are expandable) — that is why this is ⚠️, not 🚨 — but the PR's headline claim ("the engine cannot re-derive a different basis than the gate that armed it", PR description AC1) is falsified on this path, and no test pins it: UT-2 requires a boundary, E2 requires no anchors at all; the boundary-less windowed-resume case is exactly the gap between them.

**Ask**: either extend the stale-anchor curation to cover load-time anchors whose generation context the resident tail cannot vouch for (the `resetLoadedUsageAnchors` rationale, applied at projection level for boundary-less tails), or state in `refreshAgentState`'s contract why the boundary-less resume basis is acceptable and pin the decision with a UT (gate basis vs engine basis after a `maxPages`-exhausted resume, no boundary records). Pre-fix, the blanket zero made this specific path correct (engine basis = gate basis = chars/4); please confirm the regression is intended or covered elsewhere before merge.

comments.body:
**CI red classification — not caused by this branch (evidence below).** The branch's own changes are untouched; no fix push needed.

**1. `Browser extension / Headless Chrome suite` — fail (runs 44058139073, 440593232 on this PR).**
Failing test: `browser_ext/dart/test/host_compaction_test.dart` — 'AC5 — the re-fire ladder: a still-over pass re-fires exactly once, then the exhaustion notice' (`expect(outcome.exhausted, isTrue)` at :519 returns false).

Pre-existing on main, proven three ways:
- The same suite fails on the `.github`-only dependabot PR (github-actions bump, zero browser_ext/lib changes) in 6 consecutive runs: 44059070858, 44048233590, 44040428125, 4393928723, 43933360318, 43913343460 (2026-11-16 16:58 → 2026-11-17 09:49) — the identical test, identical assertion.
- Local reproduction on **pristine `origin/main` @8f526c0a85** (this branch's changes stashed): `dart test test/host_compaction_test.dart` in browser_ext/dart fails the same test; with the branch applied it fails identically (deterministic, 4+ local runs, also in isolation).
- The failure is deterministic (not flaky): 8/8 CI runs red. `scripts/test_quarantine.json` does not apply — its scope is the core Quality-gate integration legs (pty-integration / integration-mock), not the browser-ext workflow, and entries require a flake-tracker issue; this needs a direct fix (the rig's second ladder run now relieves instead of still being over — `exhausted` false — worth its own RCA: the fixture is 3 messages, window 512/reserve 128/keep 256, Usage.zero seeds, so gh-2237's anchor work cannot reach it).

Suggest filing a dedicated ci-red issue for `browser-ext.yml` — it blocks every PR touching browser_ext paths since 2026-11-16 16:58.

**2. Main's own ci.yml red (run 44046925560, Quality gate + Hostile ambient env) — unrelated to this PR.**
Failing test: `test/providers/payload_stall_test.dart` — 'late-answer adoption in the connect-stall retry loop (#1916 AC3): an abandoned attempt answering during the backoff is ADOPTED — the identical payload is never re-uploaded' — failed ONLY in the Hostile-ambient matrix (artificially degraded env). Local re-run on this branch: the full file passes 13/13, including that exact test (`dart test test/providers/payload_stall_test.dart` — All tests passed). This PR is not merged and shares only the base; the run is main code. Timing-sensitive under the hostile matrix → candidate for the red-in-2-distinct-runs quarantine watch if it recurs.

**Branch's own gates:** dart analyze full (CI-equivalent local), core compaction/agent/session/task/hosts 2157 ✓, test/cli 4591 ✓, browser_ext compaction host tests ✓ (only the pre-existing AC5 red), CodeQL ✓, merge gate ✓.

## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: One 🚨 CI red on head `34629911` must go green (or be quarantined per red-in-2-distinct-SHA-runs) before merge, and one ⚠️ code finding: the AC1 "one basis" invariant still has a reachable counterexample on boundary-less windowed resumes, where `refreshAgentState` re-arms the phantom anchors the resume path deliberately zeroed. The core fix itself is sound — projection-trust anchors, honest zero-pass receipts on both surfaces, reason threading, and the gh-2097/gh-1742 guards all verify (analyze clean; 8/8 new tests, 1332 scoped compaction/agent/hosts tests green locally; the CI-failing test passes 9/9 on this branch).

**Key Issues**:
- 🚨 **CI red — `Hostile ambient env` (commit `34629911`)**: `test/cli/agent_cli_single_render_test.dart` — "E2: a backgrounded bash call keeps its distinct settle event next to the single end row" — `FileSystemException: Deletion failed, path = '/tmp/fa_single_render_artWPCIUT' (errno = 39)`; 14664 passed / 1 failed (full log: `ci_failures_full.log`). The file is untouched by this branch (0 of 20 changed files) and passes 9/9 locally on the branch head — the hostile-matrix temp-dir cleanup race, same classification precedent as Thread 1's `payload_stall_test`. Still a required-check red: re-run to green or file the quarantine watch.
- ⚠️ **`lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart:175` — phantom-anchor basis divergence on boundary-less windowed resumes** (details in the inline thread): gate arms on chars/4, the engine's refresh re-arms the persisted pre-trim anchor, over-fold + wasted provider passes until the first boundary lands. Uncovered by UT-2/E2.
- 💡 Digest — `lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart:332`: `run()`'s docstring first sentence ("returns whether the context ended under pressure") reads inverted against the code (`true` = settled **below** the trigger); the PR edits this doc block — worth clarifying while here.
- 💡 Digest — `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart:240`: on zero-pass runs `_runTokensBefore` is null, so the HEP `compaction_end` frame is still skipped — the supervisor lane stays start-without-end for no-op runs (pre-existing; the ticket's OQ2 surfaces are covered, this is the third lane).
- 🪶 Digest — `lib/src/compaction/structured/engine.dart:357-358`: the trigger-gate reason evaluates `_requestTokens()` a second time just to render the number — one extra O(context) estimate per armed compaction; bind once into a local.

**Next Steps**:
1. Re-run the `Hostile ambient env` check to green (or quarantine the flake with a tracker issue) — the merge gate stays closed on red.
2. Answer the ⚠️: extend the stale-anchor curation to boundary-less resume tails, or document why that basis is acceptable and add the pinning UT.
3. Optionally pick up the three digest items in the same lap.
